cases.name: Michelle Akins Aumiller
cases.about:
Her obituary said, "Michelle was a 2009 graduate of Vienna High School. She attended Southeastern Illinois College at Harrisburg and received certification as a massage therapist. Michelle had worked at Ferrell Hospital in Eldorado as the billing officer and for the past six months had been employed at Integrated Health Care in Carterville.

Michelle loved music and playing the piano. She also enjoyed sports activities and hunting. She cherished time spent hanging out with her family and friends. She adored her children and was a loving mother.

Michelle was a member of Gilead Cumberland Presbyterian Church, near Simpson."
